highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 brings Apple platform TFM support and a WinUI projection fix to the v3 line.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: Consumers targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer encounter a 'DLL not found' error for the WinUI projection assembly.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs
bullets.detail: Apple targets now use the 26.0 version for library TFMs and the unversioned form for app TFMs, matching the Apple SDK conventions introduced in 4.148.0.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs to the v3 branch
